android.desc:
Foodolyst finally makes it extremely easy to track what you eat (no complicated typing, smart pre-selections) and note your ailments. This helps you to find out which foods cause discomfort. The analysis calculates correlations and assigns a score to each food. The higher the score, the more clearly the food correlates with your symptoms.

Intolerances, digestive problems etc. can finally be solved. Foodolyst impresses with:

- A distinctive database of foods
- The easy input of meals within seconds. No need to enter weights, barcodes, quantities, etc.
- Recipes and copy functions allow to quickly re-enter already made food (usually many people eat one meal on several days, so the input here works especially fast).
- Since recipes are not always cooked 100% the same, food can be removed or added from the entry with just one click. No leeks added to the lentil soup this time? No problem, enter lentil soup anyway (adds all food) and remove leek.

Foodolyst was born out of necessity as there was still no app in 2022 that combines a visually appealing UI with tracking that is as simple as possible and allows for meaningful analysis using intelligent algorithms. This is now changing and is already helping many people with their problems.

quotes.text:
I recently also developed an App to help me figure out my IBS and digestion problems. Basically i looked at all the apps in the app store but did not found a simple to use app. Inserting your meals should really be as simple as it possibly can, otherwise you will end up not using it at all.

If anyone is interested, it is currently available in the google app store. Apple coming soon. Foodolyst:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.creatness.foodolyst

Also available as a webapp: https://app.foodolyst.creatness.studio

The app works in German&English. I haven't proof read every English entry however, so feedback is very much welcomed. I can return lifetime premium access in return :)

Okay enough advertising, sorry but the topic is quite interesting and everyone with food problems can just benefit from this.
